justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Home health PT/OT effectiveness is supported; ACHH certification-specific outcomes not studied.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: APTA ACHH online self-assessment plus documentation; relatively accessible; moderate cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any home health clinician; home health is a major and growing PT/OT employment setting.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Home health services billed through Medicare OASIS per-visit; ACHH does not specifically unlock new codes but supports program quality.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Moderate demand in home health agencies; ACHH credential valued but not yet widely required.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients prefer receiving care at home; specialized home health clinicians improve confidence.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Home health is a Medicare-dominated, episodic-payment world; essentially no cash-pay consumer market.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Rates are dictated by PDGM and agency contracts; little room for premium pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Modest signal in HH hiring but invisible to consumers.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Could support a home-health agency model, but regulatory barriers and reimbursement constrain scaling.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Patients don't ask for it by name; referrals come through discharge planners.
justifications.business.efficiency: Relatively short APTA-style competency course at modest cost.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized within geriatric/HH-focused programs but not a major promotion credential.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Some applied literature on HH outcomes but not a hot scholarship area.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful for DPT instructors covering geriatrics, HH, and post-acute content.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying HH interventions have moderate evidence base.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely listed as preferred in faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Quick and affordable for what it offers.
